analyst.summary: Lemon Tree Hotels is India's largest mid-priced hotel chain, riding a strong multi-year upcycle in Indian hospitality (limited new supply, firm room rates, strong demand), with steadily rising revenue and even faster-rising profit as operating leverage kicks in. The company has a large signed pipeline of new hotels and has been paying down debt even while expanding. We rate it a Hold: the growth story and execution both look genuine, but the stock already trades at a premium that assumes this continues.
